title: Kite with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M50 72 Q42 80 48 86 Q54 92 46 96' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail bows -->
  <path d='M44 82 l-5 -3 l2 5 z' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <path d='M50 90 l5 -3 l-2 5 z' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- kite body -->
  <path d='M50 10 L82 40 L50 74 L18 40 Z' fill='#FF4E50'/>
  <!-- kite body shading panel -->
  <path d='M50 10 L82 40 L50 74 Z' fill='#E63946' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- top highlight -->
  <path d='M50 10 L66 25 L50 35 L34 25 Z' fill='#FF8C8E' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- cross spars -->
  <line x1='50' y1='10' x2='50' y2='74' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='40' x2='82' y2='40' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#2B2D42'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#2B2D42'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='34.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 46 Q50 56 60 46' stroke='#2B2D42' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FF8C8E' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FF8C8E' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- bow at bottom -->
  <path d='M46 74 Q50 70 54 74 Q50 72 46 74 Z' fill='#FFD93D'/>
</svg>
